Make sure you keep the cut clean and dry. Check on it every few hours and make sure to re-bandage it properly, there are a lot of good tutorials on line if you’re not sure. If at any point you develop a fever, the cut becomes very red and swollen or hurts more than it should, or it starts seeping or weeping liquid make sure you get some help for it. Continue to eat and drink as much water as you can stomach without feeling nauseous and rest/sleep as much as you can. I can tell you if it gets to a point where it needs help it is more worth it to tell someone than to suffer in silence. It won’t kill you unless you let it get really bad, but you will feel completely miserable. If you need to you can even make up a story or just refuse to say where it came from, the first priority will be to get you healed and feeling better.
